rules.name: Entra sequence - device-code sign-in then security-method registration
rules.description: Successful device-code sign-in followed within two hours by successful individual-method registration for the same directory and target user. Identity/time correlation, not proof of phishing or same-session activity. Legitimate onboarding is a known false positive.
rules.coverageClassification: candidate correlation; native overlap present; absence not proven

rules.name: Entra sequence - security-method registration then multi-surface Graph reads
rules.description: Successful individual-method registration followed within two hours by at least 25 distinct successful GET requests across at least three Graph resource surfaces, by the same directory/user/application. Reads can be benign; this does not establish content download or exfiltration.
rules.coverageClassification: candidate correlation; native overlap present; absence not proven

rules.name: Entra sequence - native risky sign-in then security-method registration
rules.description: Successful medium/high native-risk sign-in followed within two hours by successful individual-method registration for the same directory/user. Enriches existing Microsoft risk evidence; not a new token detector. Choose this or overlapping Defender D001 for alerting, not both without a deduplication plan.
rules.coverageClassification: native-risk enrichment; not a claimed coverage gap

defender.name: Entra native risky sign-in then self-attributed phone-app method addition
defender.limitations: Same-tenant Defender data only. Strict User_GUID target format, actor=target, and array-shaped StrongAuthenticationPhoneAppDetail required. Does not cover all authentication methods or service-mediated updates. No automatic response. Manual portal creation only after query validation.
